messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My heart felt whole when I re-realized I could help other people.

output.original_text: My heart felt whole when I re-realized I could help other people.
output.joy: I was overjoyed when I re-realized I could help other people; it made my heart feel completely whole!
output.sadness: I sadly reflected on how my heart felt whole when I re-realized I could help other people, wishing it could always be that way.
output.fear: My heart felt a mixture of fear and excitement when I re-realized I could help other people; what if I wasn't enough?
output.anger: I felt a surge of anger because I realized my heart could feel whole only by helping other people; it shouldn’t have to be that way!
output.surprise: I was so surprised when I re-realized my heart felt whole just by being able to help other people!
output.disgust: I felt a sense of disgust, realizing my heart only felt whole when helping others; why does it take that?
